row.problem_statement:
<START WRITING>
CacheAPI methods removed unexpectedly

Description

It seems that several methods from the CacheAPI class have been removed, which is causing issues with certain functionalities. The methods `export_path`, `recipe_metadata_path`, `check_integrity`, and `save` are no longer available. This change is affecting the ability to manage cache operations effectively.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Attempt to use any of the removed methods from the CacheAPI class.
2. Observe that the methods are not found, leading to errors in cache management tasks.

This regression might have been introduced in a recent refactor. It would be great to have these methods or equivalent functionality restored to ensure smooth cache operations.
